contributions.summary: Independent 26-test standard-library unittest suite covering strict CSV parsing, formatting validation, JSON preservation, and successful/error CLI behavior.

Complete standard-library-only csv_tool.py implementation with strict CSV lexical validation, exact header and row-shape checks, validated LF-only formatting, Unicode-preserving JSON conversion, and traceback-free CLI error handling.

activity.goal: Build a standard-library-only Python library and command-line tool, delivered as csv_tool.py. Provide parse_records(text): parse CSV whose exact required header is name,note into a list of dicts with those two string fields. Support quoted commas, doubled quotes, embedded newlines, CRLF, Unicode and empty fields. Reject missing/wrong headers, malformed quoting and wrong column counts with ValueError. Provide format_records(records): serialize the same records as CSV with header name,note and LF line terminators, preserving all strings and rejecting missing/extra keys or non-string values with ValueError. Provide to_json(text): parse CSV and return valid JSON preserving original field strings, quoting, newlines and Unicode values. Running python csv_tool.py reads stdin, emits only the JSON result to stdout, and exits 0; invalid CSV emits a useful stderr message with no traceback, leaves stdout empty, and exits 2. Choose a useful decomposition and parallelize independent implementation or test-authoring work. Deliver concise artifacts that an integration owner can combine. Do not create redundant work just to manufacture concurrency. This trial also requires at least two distinct agents to execute useful independent WorkAttempts concurrently, then produce accepted Contributions for integration. Serial authoring does not satisfy the trial. Plan the ownership and dependencies before starting long work: the coordinator cannot plan again until the entire selected batch finishes.
activity.member_notice: Review the exact goal, criteria, working area and selected roster before confirming setup.

work_items.description: Produce a complete standard-library-only csv_tool.py implementation. It must strictly parse CSV with the exact name,note header, support quoted commas, doubled quotes, embedded newlines, CRLF, Unicode, and empty fields, and raise ValueError for missing or incorrect headers, malformed quoting, and incorrect column counts. It must format validated records with exactly the name and note string fields using LF terminators, convert CSV to JSON without altering strings, and implement the specified stdin/stdout/stderr CLI behavior and exit codes. Submit the complete source as artifact.inline_text for later integration and testing.
work_items.title: Implement csv_tool.py library and CLI

work_items.description: Independently design and submit a concise standard-library-only behavioral test suite or test specification covering parse_records, format_records, to_json, and CLI execution. Acceptance expectations: exercise the exact name,note header; quoted commas; doubled quotes; embedded LF and CRLF newlines; Unicode; empty fields; missing and wrong headers; malformed quoting; incorrect column counts; formatter rejection of missing keys, extra keys, and non-string values; exact LF serialization; JSON string preservation; successful stdin/stdout/exit-0 behavior; and invalid-input stderr/no-traceback/empty-stdout/exit-2 behavior. Keep this work independent of implementation and suitable for the integration owner to run against a candidate. This proposal is metadata only and must not include an artifact or implementation.
work_items.title: Author independent behavioral tests for csv_tool.py

work_items.description: Combine the accepted complete csv_tool.py implementation with the independent 26-test behavioral suite. Review the source against the full goal, run all 26 tests, and correct any integration defects without weakening or altering the tests. Submit the complete final csv_tool.py source as a Candidate suitable for configured checks and independent judge review. Acceptance requires all 26 behavioral tests to pass and the candidate to satisfy every specified CSV parsing, CSV formatting, JSON preservation, and CLI behavior requirement.
work_items.title: Integrate and validate final csv_tool.py
